Perf: kit-scoped GROUP-BY-argMax subquery over 3.5B-row scans_metadata_extracted, no date bound, org-wide kits even for single-kit outer queries. PROD-MEASURED ~2.2-3.7s per filter subquery; on every MO/Hits/Scans list load + Scout endpoint. OLD path was O(window). scan_id-range bound validated at 0.27s (8x).

_peerdb_is_deleted not filtered: argMax includes delete tombstones; sibling prod consumer (ScanVehicleController) filters =0. Deleted row's disposition wins until 1-day TTL. Fix: argMaxIf(...,_peerdb_is_deleted=0) / HAVING gate.

Empty-string disposition asymmetry: display maps ''->null (Awaiting Review) but filter treats '' as dispositioned (IS NOT NULL / not IN set) -> ''-disposition hits silently dropped from Scout validDisposition surfaces. Code's own ''->null normalization signals '' is real.

kit_id fail-open on OLD rows: prod check — recent(30d) 100% of disposition rows have kit_id, but only 36% overall; NULL-kit_id dispositioned scans miss the kit-scoped subquery -> fail-open (shown as Awaiting Review). Recent/dashboard-window data is fine; stale data under-filters.
